citations.quote: With other weighting methods, not all investors could hold the index.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Index-weighting taxonomy (price/cap/equal/fundamental) plus float adjustment; only cap-weighting is macroconsistent (holdable by all investors at once), links to the CAPM market portfolio and low turnover, and makes a portfolio ratio a cap-weighted average.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Capitalization Weighting and Macroconsistency
